title: Profinite change of components of a w-local affine ring
statement: Let $C$ be a commutative ring with w-local spectrum [def-weil-pbc-w-local], and write $P=\pi_0(\operatorname{Spec}C)$ for the quotient space of connected components. Then $P$ is profinite (compact Hausdorff totally disconnected), and the map from the closed point set of $\operatorname{Spec}C$ to $P$ is a homeomorphism. For every profinite space $T$ and continuous map $u:T\to P$, there exist a commutative $C$-algebra $D$ and a homeomorphism $\operatorname{Spec}D\cong\operatorname{Spec}C\times_P T$ over $\operatorname{Spec}C$, with $\pi_0(\operatorname{Spec}D)\cong T$ over $P$. The map $C\to D$ is ind-Zariski and ind-etale [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. For every prime $\mathfrak q$ of $D$, the induced map $C_{\mathfrak q\cap C}\to D_{\mathfrak q}$ is an isomorphism. The spectrum of $D$ is w-local; its closed point set is the inverse image of the closed point set of $\operatorname{Spec}C$ and maps homeomorphically onto $T$. If $u$ is surjective, $\operatorname{Spec}D\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ is surjective.

proof.text: For the spectral space PrimeSpectrum C, infer compactness, Hausdorffness and total disconnectedness of its connected-component quotient. Apply WLocalSpace.isHomeomorph_connectedComponents_closedPoints to obtain the displayed closed-point homeomorphism.

Take the existing, explicitly constructed ring D = WContractification.PullbackProfinite C T u. It is the colimit restriction of the locally constant-function algebra to the graph of u. Use fiberHomeo and swap its two factors to give the required spectrum homeomorphism e; snd_fiberHomeo identifies its first projection with the actual structure map C → D. The construction uses no existence witness from an open theorem.

proof.text: Use PullbackProfinite.isPullback and ConnectedComponents.isHomeomorph_lift_of_isPullback to define eπ. The connectedComponentsLift computation and fst_fiberHomeo identify eπ on representatives with the second projection of e. The equation defining fiberHomeo proves compatibility over the original component quotient. ConnectedComponents.wlocalSpace_of_isPullback supplies w-locality of D, and preimage_closedPoints_eq_closedPoints_of_isPullback supplies the precise closed-point equality. Compose eπ with the w-local closed-point homeomorphism to get the closed-point homeomorphism onto T.

The existing PullbackProfinite.indZariski instance gives Algebra.IndZariski C D. Apply Algebra.IndZariski.bijectiveOnStalks and bijective_localRingHom to obtain bijectivity of each induced localization homomorphism. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-local-rings-ind-zariski] to these bijections and the established w-locality of D to obtain IsIndPrincipalZariski C D in the stronger principal-localization sense. Independently obtain IndEtale C D from Algebra.IndEtale.of_indZariski.
When u is surjective, apply PullbackProfinite.projSpec_surjective. Its projection is definitionally the structure-map spectrum comap, giving the final clause without any nonemptiness assumption.
